summary: Only a count's residue modulo ten affects the units digit, so the optimal implementation checks at most ten counts. The source also fixes num to 0 through 3000 and k to one decimal digit, leaving no unbounded workload for scaling.

replacement_checks.evidence: The residues of count * k repeat within ten consecutive positive counts, so a feasible units digit appears among counts 1 through 10 or never appears.
Regression checks every one of the 30,010 legal (num, k) pairs against an independent unbounded-coin dynamic program.
